products.title: Starvie Junior 2025 - Star Vie
products.description:
STARVIE JUNIOR 2025 - Starvie's junior racket, for children who are starting out in this sport. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Are you looking for a junior racket? The STARVIE JUNIOR 2025 is one of the alternatives we have for the little ones. Quality alternative, very comfortable and light weight.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended for a child who is starting to play.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The STARVIE JUNIOR 2025 has the following characteristics:

- Round shape. It ensures low balance and good mobility.

- Low weight. Its weight is around 330 grams.

- Made of fiberglass.

- Xtreme Spot technology that increases the sweet spot.

PLAY STYLE

It is a wing with a lot of control, ideal for learning correctly in the first steps in this wonderful sport.

products.title: Enebe Genius Red 2026 - Enebe
products.description:
ENEBE GENIUS RED 2026 - Enebe padel racket with a spectacular design. Round format, medium balance and 3K carbon fiber. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The ENEBE GENIUS RED 2026 is a racket that does not need much introduction. The design says it all and we love it. Round shovel, with a radical design, a very, very modern new format. A high-end professional model.

PLAYER TYPE

Precision, control and character. This padel racket is designed for players looking for these three characteristics. Advanced model that the higher our level, the better we will find it.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

With its oversized round format and low balance, this racket gives you the control you need to dominate the most demanding exchanges from the back of the court. Thanks to this very peculiar format, it incorporates a longer than normal fist, which will give us extra comfort in two-handed backhand shots.

Made entirely of 3K carbon fiber. It is the most rigid material in the brand, which favors both power and extra durability.

products.title: Wilson Endure Pro V1 2026 - Momo González - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ - A new era is about to begin with this jewel from Wilson Padel. Momo González's shovel. Intended for players who want the best control in their game. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL 

We present to you the most special Wilson Padel racket of the entire season, the WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ model, a racket with total maneuverability. It is Momo González's own model. If you are a fan of the round shape, this is yours. Its format will help us a lot to achieve a safe game from any area of ​​the court.

PLAYER TYPE

This racket is intended for players who want control over the ball, although it gives us a lot of power, thanks to its materials, it is a racket with 100% control, with a perfect round format and an ideal low balance.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The new WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ has materials that make it special. Deep work has been done on it to offer a completely new racket, with unique materials. On the planes, it incorporates unidirectional 3K carbon fiber. This new carbon treatment offers extra flexibility and much more resistance.

The interior incorporates dual-density foam called Control Foam, which improves the connection with the ball. This type of material offers incredible control over the ball.

One of the technologies it offers us is its double and reinforced Y-BEAM bridge, which helps us achieve better balance and reduce vibrations. It is a great padel racket to reduce arm discomfort.

products.title: Super Pack Drop Shot Carat Pro - Drop Shot
products.description:

products.title: Pala Pickleball Adidas Adipower Ctrl 3 - Palas De Pickleball
products.description:
ADIDAS ADIPOWER CTRL 3 PICKLEBALL RACKET - It is focused on experienced players looking to master the rhythm of the game. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The ADIDAS ADIPOWER CTRL 3 PICKLEBALL RACKET is a high-performance model designed for players who want precision, control and stability in their game.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Its control format results in a centered and wide sweet spot. With a 14 mm profile, it offers a good balance between rigidity and feel.

The ADIDAS ADIPOWER CTRL 3 PICKLEBALL RACKET is built with 24K aluminized carbon fiber that provides good durability and a unique feel.

The Classic Multilayers construction combines several layers of carbon with an HD Polypropylene Honeycomb core that generates a firmer feel.

As for the rest of the technologies that we can highlight, we find the Spin Blade Max (rough surface that enhances the effects); Structural Reinforcement (carbon perimeter reinforcement); Upgraded Edge Guard (perimeter protector that protects the edges of the racket); Extra Power Grip (elongated handle); Comfort Grip (padded and perforated EVA grip for greater comfort).
